summary.prose: Implement the approved 30-minute inactivity policy in five ordered tasks, preserving useful feedback and the removed-engine boundary. Native activity and controller protocol support the separate S4 progress story; no presentation or design-review redesign is included.

tasks.title: Define activity execution contracts and inactivity monitor
tasks.summary: Introduce bounded/activity execution union, provider capability, host-owned 30-minute monotonic monitor, separately tracked tools and bounded factual diagnostic snapshots. Preserve non-task bounded calls; explicitly refuse unsupported Ollama task mode before execution.
acceptanceChecks: Activity mode forbids fixed deadlines/stall watchdogs and automatic retries; malformed mixed options reject
Meaningful activity extends 30-minute grace; heartbeat, poll and duplicate events do not; tool IDs/ages remain separate
Monotonic fake-clock expiry and injected local-pressure/unknown diagnostics are deterministic
Ollama opt-in task activity refuses before model calls; existing bounded behavior unchanged

tests.name: Fake-clock monitor: progress beyond expected duration, 1800000ms expiry, no heartbeat/replay renewal and separate tool ages
Execution union rejects mixed timers; capability/Ollama refusal before execution; factual diagnostic classification

tasks.title: Add bounded native CLI activity streams and candidate parsing
tasks.summary: Add opt-in no-wall-clock process mode, incremental UTF-8 stdout observation/backpressure and bounded diagnostics. Claude task sessions use stream-json flags; Codex parses JSONL as received. Normalize allowlisted native metadata and emit complete candidate events without treating draft or acknowledgements as results.
acceptanceChecks: Neither process timeout nor old first-output/raw-stdout watchdog is armed in activity mode; explicit group cancellation remains
Both adapters recognize fixture-verified model/tool events with serial callbacks and per-session identity
8 MiB frame/4 MiB candidate/64 KiB diagnostic bounds and queue backpressure hold; overflow stops explicitly without truncation
Candidate recognition is conservative: Claude complete StructuredOutput input, Codex unambiguous final item or successful-turn fallback; acknowledgements and partial JSON excluded
Existing non-task CLI envelope/schema behavior and timeout handling remain unchanged
Native fixtures identify their actual source/dialect; locally available CLI metadata may be inspected without model calls; no fabricated live-proof claim

tests.name: Claude/Codex fixture streams: incremental UTF-8, partial frames, tool IDs, candidate recognition and conservative final-output fallback
Activity process has no fixed timer/watchdog, explicit cancellation kills group, buffers/queues remain bounded and non-task mode unchanged

tasks.title: Integrate daemon review supervision and durable feedback commits
tasks.summary: Replace size deadlines in TaskReviewCoordinator with shared task monitor and activity provider mode, including serial attribution. Serialize validation, atomic completed-task persistence and expiry; accept durable results before wrapper cleanup, retain incomplete work honestly, and check provider capability before admission writes.
acceptanceChecks: Progressing tasks survive former S/M/L limits; one current-task monitor spans serial attribution/task sessions
Actual inactivity cancels owned subprocess and records incomplete without repeating completed tasks
Complete candidates pass existing schema/scope/evidence assessment before checkpoint write; receipt/cleanup only after durability
Candidate-then-crash retains committed assessment; invalid/conflicting/unsaved candidate never passes; write failure preserves prior durable history
Attribution candidates cannot become task results; no automatic review retry or old engine fallback

tests.name: Daemon task activity survives old limits; attribution/task session identity; expiry persists incomplete without automatic retry
Durable candidate vs crash/expiry/write failure/conflicting duplicate; validate before commit, receipt after checkpoint and cleanup

tasks.title: Add controller activity exchanges with generation fencing
tasks.summary: Use the same inactivity policy for ControllerTaskReview. Add codeReview.task.activity and timing capability to explicit task protocol, sequence/host execution identity on activity/scope/result, exact replay receipts and new generation on resume. Preserve trusted ownership and existing disconnect/retrigger rules.
acceptanceChecks: Actual IPC exercises task/attempt/execution identity, strictly ordered events and wrong-owner rejection
Frames expose activity timing and advisory expectation, omit legacy remainingMs; unsupported timing clients refuse explicitly
Polling/replayed accepted events do not renew; stale generation output cannot finish resumed work
Controller and daemon terminal-result/expiry/write-failure behavior agree; disconnect does not silently continue controller work
Normal MCP migration/S4 user-visible presentation remain outside this task
Removed insrc_review_step, insrc_code_review_step and old review RPCs continue throwing PENDING REVIEW RE-IMPLEMENTATION

tests.name: Real IPC controller activity envelope: owner/generation/sequence fencing, exact replay receipts, poll non-renewal and resume
Controller/daemon expiry and persistence parity; capability/timing refusal and removed endpoints remain unavailable

tasks.title: Verify recovery, compatibility and deployable timeout behavior
tasks.summary: Add end-to-end deterministic regressions for both adapters and routes, preserved bounded provider calls, result durability, cancellation/resource cleanup and removed review boundary invariants. Document new activity contract and internal diagnostic limits; build and retain test evidence without paid model/full repository sweeps.
acceptanceChecks: Fake-time tests cover long progress, exactly 30-minute inactivity, long silent tools, local-pressure/unknown diagnostics and delayed event-loop wake
Both native CLI fixture streams cover valid feedback then crash, candidate-expiry race, write failure, malformed frames, bounded output and group cleanup
Current checkpoint/CR history and explicit resume remain valid; unrelated bounded Ollama/CLI tests and retired exception tests pass
Production build and focused relevant suites pass; test evidence distinguishes deterministic fixtures from live model proof
Handoff exposes normalized activity for separate STORY-e6ddcdcb3d9cf330-s4 without implementing its presentation or the future design-review epic

tests.name: End-to-end deterministic recovery: two CLI adapters/routes, silent tools/local-pressure/unknown telemetry, no repeated completed task
Production build plus focused task-review, provider, IPC and retired-boundary regression suites; no paid/live or full repository sweep
